name: The Perfect Love Story Includes A Cage
source:
Are you a fan of yanderes? Well in this game, YOU get to be the yandere!

Meet the new absolute LOVE OF YOUR LIFE AND CURRENT OBSESSION Antero! You saw him and immediately knew- 

♡ He was meant to be yours ♡

Will you suppress your yandere urges and try to have a normal relationship with him? Or give in fully and embrace destiny (and your own obsession)? Or perhaps you'll change your mind? Maybe destiny was wrong after all...

[From [url=https://corvidscauldron.itch.io/the-perfect-love-story-includes-a-cage]itch.io[/url]]
